$sources: BNBC 2020 gives no shop drawing conventions; Part 6 Chapter 10 follows AISC 360-05, whose fabrication practice uses AWS A2.4 weld symbols (the structural sheets' connection details already do); the drilling allowances and the cope clearance are SAEngine practice; see VERIFY.md
source: SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 is silent (AWS A2.4 symbols as the connection details; allowances of steel fabrication practice)

sources.weldSymbols: SAEngine practice: AWS A2.4, as the steel connection details of the structural sheets (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 10 is AISC 360-05 based)
sources.anchorHoleClearance: SAEngine practice: rod + 6 mm in the base plate (fabrication tolerance for cast-in rods; the AISC Design Guide 1 holes with plate washers are larger)
sources.copeClearance: SAEngine practice: 10 mm clear of the supporting beam's flange and root
